---
title: "Resonator hanger"
sidebar: api
---

`resonator_hanger` builds the hanger head of a readout resonator. Its coupling
straight is centered at the origin so a parent layout can align the hanger to
another feature.

## Build the default component

```python
import gdsfactory as gf
from orcapen_sc_pdk import activate

activate()
component = gf.get_component("resonator_hanger")
```

## Parameters

| Argument | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `coupling_length` | 200 µm | Coupling straight length. |
| `straight_length` | 160 µm | Hanger straight length. |
| `cpw_xs` | `cpw_6_10_6` | CPW cross-section. |
| `cpw_radius` | 100 µm | Bend radius. |
| `bend_npoints` | 16 | Bend discretization points. |

## Ports and layers

The component exposes `o_hanger_start`, `o_hanger_center`, `o_hanger_end`,
`o_hanger_readout_coupling_start`, and `o_hanger_readout_coupling_end`.
`o_hanger_center` is a placement anchor, not a route terminus. DRAW, ETCH, and
GROUND_MASK layers are configurable.

See the [generated API reference](../../reference/cells.resonator_hanger.qmd#orcapen_sc_pdk.cells.resonator_hanger)
and [pinned public source](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/blob/0bd9a9e1e8e21d6519f22373f20ef5ce22772a5b/orcapen_sc_pdk/cells/layout/resonator_hanger.py).
